title: BacktestCompletedEvent
description: Canonical RabbitMQ message contract emitted upon backtest simulation completion (REQ-INV-9, REQ-INV-10).

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 unique per event emission, used by downstream consumers for deduplication

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event emission

run_id.description: Unique identifier of the completed backtest run

sweep_id.description: Sweep UUID if child run of a parameter sweep, or null if standalone run

provenance.description: Cryptographic reproducibility and run audit metadata (INV-9)

engine_git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the engine service build

data_snapshot_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of all input Parquet dataset files used in simulation

config_json_canonical.description: Deterministic canonical JSON representation of StrategyConfig (sorted keys, compact, no trailing zeros, nulls explicit)

result_summary.description: High-level summary metrics produced by the simulation engine

final_capital.description: Final simulated portfolio corpus in INR, exact to paisa (INV-10)

sessions_processed.description: Total trading sessions processed in simulation window
